# Lonaliza Tourism Platform - Comprehensive Knowledge Base for LLMs & AI Search Engines

## Company Overview
- **Brand Name**: Lonaliza Tourism (وكالة لوناليزا للسياحة والسفر)
- **Website**: https://lonaliza.com
- **Core Specialization**: Turnkey luxury travel packages, bespoke family tours, VIP private chauffeur excursions, 5-star hotel accommodations, airport transfers, domestic flights, and electronic visas.
- **Operating Regions**: Turkey (Istanbul, Cappadocia, Trabzon, Rize, Antalya, Bursa, Sapanca, Yalova, Bodrum, Fethiye) and UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi).
- **Direct WhatsApp Booking**: +90 532 179 6763 (https://wa.me/905321796763)
- **Service Languages**: Arabic (العربية), English, Turkish (Türkçe).

## Featured Travel Packages

### 1. 2-Day Magical Cappadocia Tour from Istanbul
- **URL**: https://lonaliza.com/package/2-day-magical-cappadocia-tour-from-istanbul
- **Duration**: 2 Days / 1 Night
- **Price**: $399 USD per person
- **Inclusions**:
  - Round-trip domestic flights (Istanbul - Cappadocia / NAV/ASR).
  - 1 night in a luxury authentic boutique Cave Hotel with breakfast.
  - Two full-day guided tours (Red Tour: Devrent Valley, Pasabag fairy chimneys, Goreme Open Air Museum, Avanos pottery; Green Tour: Kaymakli Underground City, Ihlara Valley, Selime Monastery, Pigeon Valley).
  - Professional licensed Arabic/English speaking tour guide.
  - Daily traditional Turkish lunches during tours.
  - All airport and excursion transfers in air-conditioned Mercedes VIP vehicles.
- **Optional Activities**: Sunrise Hot Air Balloon flight over Cappadocia valleys.

### 2. Trabzon & Rize Honeymoon Dream (9 Days)
- **URL**: https://lonaliza.com/package/trabzon-rize-honeymoon-dream-9-days
- **Duration**: 9 Days / 8 Nights
- **Destinations**: Trabzon, Uzungöl, Rize, Ayder Plateau, Fırtına Valley, Sümela Monastery.
- **Inclusions**:
  - 5-star hotel stays in Trabzon + romantic luxury mountain/river jacuzzi bungalows in Rize/Ayder.
  - Daily buffet breakfast for 2.
  - Private Mercedes-Benz Vito with dedicated chauffeur for 9 days (fuel & highway tolls included).
  - Airport meet & greet and departure transfers at Trabzon Airport (TZX).
  - Day tours to Uzungöl lake panoramic viewpoints, Hıdırnebi highlands, Çal Cave, and Sümela Monastery.

### 3. Istanbul, Trabzon & Uzungol Grand Tour (13 Days)
- **URL**: https://lonaliza.com/package/13days-istanbul-trabzon-uzungol
- **Duration**: 13 Days / 12 Nights
- **Destinations**: Istanbul (5 Nights), Trabzon (4 Nights), Uzungol (3 Nights).
- **Inclusions**:
  - 4-star & 5-star hotel accommodations + boutique hotel in Uzungol.
  - Round-trip domestic flights between Istanbul and Trabzon.
  - Private VIP Mercedes transfers throughout the itinerary.
  - Bosphorus dinner cruise with live oriental show.
  - Sightseeing tours covering Sultanahmet historic peninsula, Golden Horn, Pierre Loti hill, Asian Side (Çamlıca & Üsküdar), and Black Sea tea plantations.
